meaning.meaning_en: This meme features a girl making an exaggerated, cutesy 'ermahgerd' face while holding a pile of books, expressing an over-the-top, childish excitement or possessiveness. The text boxes are used to replace the words in her catchphrase, typically with a cutesified or 'baby talk' version of a phrase (e.g., 'ermahgerd', 'memes') and a statement of ownership or triumph (e.g., 'they are mine').
